briefing.geography: A height-four ice-quarry scarp feeds a dry canal through three stage gates into a height-minus-two basin ringed by domes, rows, the weather spire, and Ark yards.
goals: Work the ice quarry above the basin.
Defend stage-gates C1, C2, and C3 along the feeder canal.
Build at the rim domes, weather spire, seed rows, and Ark yards while watching the dust-devil lane.
rules: The north ice-quarry scarp stands at height four above a central basin floor at height minus two.
The feeder canal begins dry; C1, C2, and C3 mark its stage gates.
Dust devils follow a telegraphed wander lane.

buildables.meaning: Lights the dark and slows what it touches; radius 8wu.
Timber that holds. Bandits break it before you.
Works the river for you: 3g per cycle beside water.
Holds +150 gold above the pan cap.
Spark bolts, line-of-sight, 16wu range.
Write orders; the town's craftsmen answer. One per claim.
